[EN] You found the hiding tuwangi and gave him courage.
[ES] Encontraste al tuwangi escondido y le diste valor.

[EN] Baba tuwangi scared of big frog. He hid. Time for ceremony. Must find him!Where do you think he is?
[ES] Baba tuwangi tiene miedo de la rana grande. Se escondió. Es hora de la ceremonia. ¡Debemos encontrarlo!Where do you think he is?

[EN] So many hiding places! But small tuwangi cannot have run far.

Here drum. Find hiding spot and hit drum to bring tuwangi out.I'll help.
[ES] ¡Tantos lugares para esconderse! Pero un pequeño tuwangi no puede haber corrido muy lejos.

Aquí tienes un tambor. Encuentra el escondite y golpea el tambor para sacar al tuwangi.I'll help.

[EN] Scared Tuwangi I can help.
[ES] Tuwangi asustado I can help.

[EN] Why so much fire?
[ES] ¿Por qué tanto fuego?

[EN] Is it time to eat dragons?
[ES] ¿Es hora de comer dragones?

[EN] Growing up is hard.
[ES] Crecer es difícil.

[EN] Baba tuwangi returned! Now celebration can begin. You make good tuwangi.
[ES] ¡Baba tuwangi regresó! Ahora la celebración puede comenzar. Eres un buen tuwangi.
